payload.body_they: {{Name}} notices quickly when another person has more control over a situation than they do, especially around access, money, information, or the terms of a decision. Once they see the imbalance, they may keep pushing for an explanation or acknowledgement long after the other person's behavior has already made the situation clear. They do not need somebody else to admit what happened before deciding what they will do next. Sometimes the useful choice is simply giving the situation less access to their time, attention, or money.
